title: Right axilla
phaseLabels: Rotate through the center to the short axis

anatomySource.label: Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein · HRA female skin v1.3

sourceNote: The HRA skin supplies the chest and shoulder. The right arm is posed outward to expose the axilla. The node, hilum and neighboring vessels and muscle are illustrative anatomy in the right anterior fold.
simulationNote: The same modeled flattening under the probe drives the 3D scene and B-mode section. The shallow long-axis view centers on the node. As the probe rotates into short axis, the field deepens to show nearby vessels.
referenceContext: The oval-node reference illustrates cortical and hilar morphology. The short-axis regional reference shows the axillary vessels and surrounding muscles.
